summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would change when certain visa decisions are considered to have been made.
It would clarify the rules for submitting another protection visa application after a refusal.
It would add a requirement that a protection visa applicant must not be found to be a security risk by the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation.
changes: Specify that a visa decision is taken to be made when a record is created, not when it is told to the person.
Clarify how the bar on making a further protection visa application operates.
Make it a condition for granting a protection visa that the applicant is not assessed as a risk to security by ASIO.
summary.affected: Visa applicants, review applicants, former visa holders, and the Minister or his delegate.

speeches.brief: The Selection of Bills Committee presented its 11th report of 2013, recommending six bills be referred to specific committees for inquiry with set reporting dates, including the Environment Legislation Amendment Bill 2013 (report by 12 February 2014) and the Criminal Code Amendment (Harming Australians) Bill 2013 (report by 4 March 2014).
